scope: Independent native degree transforms, leaf-to-parent BP accumulation, explicit identity curves, physical absolute coordinates and transient animation progress. Public Math/Float32 black-box observations; no proprietary core source read or translated.
verified_semantics: Interpolate Float32 authored degrees; save negative wrapping before double radians/trig and Float32 matrix coefficients.
Combine current helper with nearest parent, then each ancestor, saving every Float32 sum; parent aggregate reuse changes rounding.
Explicit identity BP executes world UV/Bezier Float32 saving; never silently skip it as a mathematical identity.

Physical absolute anchor multiplies saved Float32 reciprocal of double(instance_scale)*double(author_scale), saves Float32, then subtracts previous saved anchor. External displacement remains author units.
Curve uses transient double(current_saved_progress + saved_Float32_increment); progress cache independently saved Float32. Value multiplication and final sum remain double until final save.
